how.label: How Frank works for marketers
how.sub: Frank continuously interviews your market across signup flows, purchases, abandoned carts, churn moments, and customer segments, giving you a live stream of messaging intelligence.
steps: Frank extracts real customer phrasing you can plug directly into your landing pages, ads, sales funnels and scripts, email marketing campaigns, offers, and retargeting campaigns.
Learn what drives people to click, buy, hesitate, compare, trust, or leave: why they chose to act now, what nearly stopped them, and which problem felt urgent enough to finally push them forward.
Use real interview insights to improve low-converting landing pages, underperforming ad hooks, confusing upsells and offers, pricing hesitations, trust issues and more.
Interview customers by typical segments like country, gender, age or persona, or embed Frank in specific funnels and understand customers coming from different campaign sources and offers.
